item.title: 📅 The Week Ahead — Nov 20–26
item.description: The Telluride School Board holds a special meeting Friday morning with a first reading of Policy JJJ, a revised extracurricular eligibility policy that incorporates Colorado's statutory definitions of male and female for athletic team participation — the kind of thing worth knowing about before it moves further. The rest of the week is lighter on government business, with several agency agendas still unposted, while the community side of things picks up with the gondola reopening for winter, the Girl Winter Film Tour, a People's March on Saturday, and Thanksgiving week rolling in with Turkey Trots and Friendsgiving on both ends.

item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Telluride Board of Education Special Meeting — 2026-11-20
item.description:
Telluride School District • 2026-11-20
A special meeting with a lot packed into one Friday morning. The board takes up a first reading of Policy JJJ — a revised extracurricular eligibility policy that incorporates Colorado's statutory definitions of male and female for athletic team participation, along with updated rules for homeschooled, charter, and nonpublic-school students seeking to participate in district activities. Then the meeting moves into executive session on two fronts: selecting a superintendent search consultant (with reference-check materials protected under CORA's mandatory nondisclosure provisions), and a personnel matter involving Superintendent John Pandolfo. Coming out of executive session, the board votes on approving the search consultant and any investigative action tied to the Pandolfo matter. The board also conducts a self-assessment under GP-4-E.
⚡ Why it matters: Board takes first reading of gender-eligibility athletic policy with public implications.

item.title: [Fri, Nov 20] Cancer Support Group
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Magazine Room 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Join us for a supportive and compassionate space at our Cancer Support Group held every 3rd Thursday of the month from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM . This group is designed for individuals currently experiencing cancer and for those who are in remission, offering a safe and welcoming environment for sharing personal stories, experiences, and encouragement. Whether you're navigating your cancer journey or reflecting on the road to recovery, this group provides emotional support and the opportunity to connect with others who understand your unique challenges. Come and find strength in the community, share your experiences, and know you're not alone in your journey.

item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Wilkinson Public Library 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Register here to step into a sprawling world of celestial magic, political intrigue, and ancient prophecies with New York Times bestselling author Rebecca Roanhorse as we dive deep into her acclaimed Between Earth and Sky trilogy. Black Sun , Fevered Star , and Mirrored Heavens are inspired by the rich and diverse cultures of the pre-Columbian Americas, reshaping modern speculative fiction with unmissable worldbuilding. Black Sun, the first book in the trilogy, introduces us to the holy city of Tova. The winter solstice is usually a time for celebration and renewal, but this year it coincides with a solar eclipse, a rare celestial event proscribed by the Sun Priest as an unbalancing of the world. Meanwhile, a ship launches from a distant city bound for Tova and set to arrive on the solstice. …

item.title: [Mon, Nov 23] Around The World: America’s Pumpkin Beer & Chocolate Pretzels
item.description: 🎫 KOTO Owner and Brewmaster, TJ is taking us on a journey to early America to discover how a humble native gourd became our continent’s most iconic seasonal tradition. Long before pumpkin spice became a modern phenomenon, early American colonists relied on native pumpkins to survive winter and celebrate the harvest holidays. Join us for a curated tasting event exploring the rich history of American pumpkin brewing paired with traditional European-style chocolate pretzels. Grab your tasting passport, explore the global trade routes that brought us holiday spices, and toast to the historic flavors of the American harvest season! (Ages 21+ only).
